name: XOXO, He Dumped the Queen Bee for ME
original_name: XOXO, He Dumped the Queen Bee for ME
overview: Vera was abandoned, abused, and left for dead by her sister and foster parents. Then, the wealthiest family in town offered her a deal: destroy their dumb love-struck son's relationship with Blair, Vera's gold-digging younger sister. At school, Blair is stunned when Vera appears. Blair still looks down on her, completely unaware that the sister she once treated like trash was about to take everything from her: the heart of the richest heir and his family's limitless wealth. "You're nothing but a lowlife!" Blair threatens.  "Don't speak too soon, sis," Vera whispers,  "Everything you have, I'm taking it back piece by piece!"

trailers.title: XOXO, He Dumped the Queen Bee for ME | Revenge, Comeback | Short Drama
